Enabled.Name: Reroll Bonus: Enable
Enabled.Hint: When enabled, rerolling a check with a Hero Point adds the bonus below to the new roll's total.

Bonus.Name: Reroll Bonus: Amount
Bonus.Hint: Added to the rerolled d20 total. Dice bonuses are rolled (and shown by Dice So Nice) alongside the d20.

Label.Name: Reroll Bonus: Label
Label.Hint: Flavor text on the bonus term in the roll formula and chat badge. Blank = "Hero Point".
